Case Study

2026-10-13

some questions

  • where are the most expensive airbnbs in nyc?
  • which neighborhood has the highest concentration?
  • which one is the cheapest?
  • which airbnb hosts are the most/best reviewed?
  • has the number increased or decreased over time?
  • do airbnbs affect rent in their neighborhoods/buildings?
  • do descriptions correlate with price?
  • what about text reviews?
nyc_airbnb =
  nyc_airbnb
nyc_airbnb |> 
  count(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = n
  )
## # A tibble: 5 × 4
##   neighbourhood_group `Entire home/apt` `Private room` `Shared room`
##   <chr>                           <int>          <int>         <int>
## 1 Bronx                             192            429            28
## 2 Brooklyn                         7427           9000           383
## 3 Manhattan                       10814           7812           586
## 4 Queens                           1388           2241           192
## 5 Staten Island                     116            144             1
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  count(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = n
  )
## # A tibble: 1 × 4
##   neighbourhood_group `Entire home/apt` `Private room` `Shared room`
##   <chr>                           <int>          <int>         <int>
## 1 Manhattan                       10814           7812           586

price

nyc_airbnb |> 
  group_by(neighbourhood_group) |> 
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(price)) |> 
  filter(price_rank < 10)

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(price > 1000) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = price)) +
  geom_histogram() +  
  facet_grid(room_type ~ neighbourhood_group)
## `stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value `binwidth`.

prices on average

nyc_airbnb |> 
  group_by(neighbourhood_group, room_type) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_price = mean(price)
    ) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = mean_price
  )
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by neighbourhood_group and room_type.
## ℹ Output is grouped by neighbourhood_group.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(neighbourhood_group, room_type))` for per-operation
##   grouping (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
## # A tibble: 5 × 4

median price

nyc_airbnb |> 
  group_by(neighbourhood_group, room_type) |> 
  summarize(
    median_price = median(price)
    ) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = median_price
  )
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.

## 4 Queens                           119              60            39

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  filter(room_type != "Shared room") |> 
  mutate(neighbourhood_gorup = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbourhood, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid(. ~ room_type) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

visualize price some more

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = lat, y = long, color = price)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5)

leaflet map

pal = colorNumeric(
  palette = "viridis",
  domain = 1:500
)

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  # sample_n(50) |> 
  leaflet() |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  addCircleMarkers(
    ~lat, ~long, color = ~pal(price), radius = 0.5)
